summary: Frontend-only test of instructor dances Drafts/Published toggle flow. All 7 criteria verified: (1) instr-tab-dances renders, (2) toggle chips 'Drafts (N)' + 'Published (N)' visible with correct counts, (3) Drafts view shows only is_published=false cards, (4) tapping Publish removes card instantly, decrements Drafts count, increments Published count, and shows success toast '"ZZ Test Draft..." is published 🎉', (5) Published view shows card with 'Unpublish' button; tapping shows info toast 'moved back to Drafts' and card leaves list, (6) empty states render correctly — 'All caught up — no drafts waiting to be published' (testID instr-drafts-empty) and 'No published dances yet.' (testID instr-published-empty), (7) test dance deleted via DELETE /api/dances/{id} (404 confirmed). No regressions, no console errors blocking the flow.
